simple.meaning: שִׁיר (shîyr) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a song ; abstractly, singing.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 91 times across Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Judges, and 12 more, beginning at Genesis 31:27. Its contexts include family line, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שִׁיר (H7892).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
